create_datetime_range: create a datetime range between two bounds with a specified interval and closed interval
create_datetime_ranges: create a column of datetime ranges from start and end expressions for each row
run_datetime_range_eager: run datetime_range in eager mode to return a Series instead of an expression
run_datetime_range_with_timezone: run datetime_range with a specified time zone and time unit for timezone-aware datetimes
run_datetime_range_in_group_by: run datetime_range inside a group_by aggregation to generate per-group datetime lists
